title.zh: v2.0.83 改 FX 参数不再重建音频图：拖速度滑杆不再把主滤波器拽出链路
title.en: v2.0.83 Writing an FX Value No Longer Rebuilds the Audio Graph

highlights.zh: **`setFilter` 无条件重连图，而它在每次 BPM 变化时都会被调用。** `updateFilterRouting()` 先把两条边都断开再重接——在实时图里这不是空操作，而是**主链路上一次短暂的断路**（听感上就是咔哒）。而 `applyGenreFxToGraph()` 在**每次 pattern 替换和每次 BPM 变化**时都会调用 `setFilter`，所以只要滤波器开着，**拖速度滑杆就会把主滤波器拽出链路再装回来一次**（每个输入事件一次）。
highlights.en: **`setFilter` re-routed the graph unconditionally, and it is called on every BPM change.** `updateFilterRouting()` disconnects both edges before reconnecting them — not a no-op in a live graph, but a brief **open circuit in the master path** (a click). And `applyGenreFxToGraph()` calls `setFilter` on every pattern set *and every BPM change*, so with the filter engaged, **dragging the tempo slider pulled the master filter out of the chain and put it back once per input event*…

highlights.zh: **修法：路由只取决于开关状态。** 记下上次为哪个 `filterEnabled` 值布线，值变化只写参数、不动图（频率/Q/类型仍是**步进**写入——这是刻意的：`ChannelStripDsp.writeParam` 的注释说明步进才能让离线渲染逐位一致，不是这次的缺陷）。
highlights.en: **The fix: the routing depends on the enable flag alone.** The rack now records which `filterEnabled` value the edges were built for, so a value change writes parameters without touching the graph. Frequency, Q and type are still written as **steps**, deliberately: the comment in `ChannelStripDsp.writeParam` records that a step keeps the offline render bit-identical.

highlights.zh: **测试（`effectsRackRewiring.test.ts`，3 条）**：连续改 cutoff/Q 时 `disconnectCalls` 一次都不涨（而参数确实写进去了）、开关滤波器仍然重连且重连后的边正确、以及**走用户真实路径**——`applyGenreFxToGraph` 连调 5 个不同 BPM，已开启的滤波器一次都没被重连。为此给测试用的 `FakeNode` 加了 `disconnectCalls`：断开一条边再接回同一条边，在实时图里不是空操作。把 `setFilter` 改回无条件重连实测 **2 条失败**；全量单测 177 文件 / 2042 用例。
highlights.en: **Tests (`effectsRackRewiring.test.ts`, 3):** consecutive cutoff/Q writes leave `disconnectCalls` unchanged while the values really are written; switching the filter in and out still re-routes, with the right edges afterwards; and the real path — `applyGenreFxToGraph` at five different BPMs leaves an engaged filter untouched. The test `FakeNode` gained a `disconnectCalls` counter, because tearing an edge down and rebuilding the identical one is not a no-op in a live graph. R…
